name: Matthew T. Wharton
residence: Sweetwater County (he wrote that he was raised in the county and graduated from Green River High School)
occupation: Law-enforcement investigator; in an August 2026 Green River Star voter-guide statement he wrote that he has spent 20 years in public service, with a career that began in detention, continued in patrol, and has included a decade in investigations, including work as an affiliate investigator with the Wyoming Internet Crimes Against Children Task Force
education: Green River High School (Green River Star, Aug. 6, 2026, voter-guide statement)
military: U.S. Army, four years of active duty as an infantryman (Green River Star, Aug. 6, 2026, voter-guide statement)
background: Matthew T. Wharton ran in the 2026 Republican primary for Sweetwater County sheriff. In a Green River Star voter-guide statement he wrote that he was raised in the county, graduated from Green River High School, served four years on active duty in the U.S. Army as an infantryman, and has spent 20 years in public service, beginning in detention, continuing in patrol, and including a decade in investigations, with more than 3,400 hours of training and service as an affiliate investigator with the Wyoming Internet Crimes Against Children Task Force. He lost the August 18, 2026, Republican primary.
